name: HEVC Compact Database
description: Compact 4K HEVC profiles for Radarr and Sonarr. Movies prefer the shared elite Blu-ray score (hallowed, BHDStudio, HONE and the rest of that list), then a smaller disc, then FLUX/Kitsune/CMRG, then a PSA micro, then BYNDR or NTb. Inside a class, Dolby Vision is +1000, HDR is +500, HDR10+ is +600, Dolby Digital + is +125, and Dolby Digital is +115. 4K Blu-ray without HDR is rejected, and so is Dolby Vision with no HDR fallback. TrueHD and DTS-HD are rejected for direct play. The cap is 200 MB/min, so a long movie is not penalized for a large file.
